observations: Photo 0 shows the exterior of a black retail box for a Nikon Z 6II camera.
The box is closed; the camera and accessories are not visible.
The box surface shows significant scuffing and reflections.
There is a watermark 'DON KINGSLEY' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlaid on the image.

claims.claim: All accessories available inside the carton
claims.evidence: Photo 0 only shows the closed exterior of the box.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different item.
risks.proof: Photo of the camera body and accessories outside of the box.

risks.risk: The camera may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.

risks.risk: The sensor may be scratched or dirty.
risks.proof: Clear, close-up photo of the sensor with the body cap removed.

proof_requests: Photos of the actual camera body from multiple angles (front, back, top, bottom).
Photo of the camera sensor with the cap removed.
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, strap) laid out.
Video of the camera powering on and the rear LCD screen functioning.
Photo of the camera next to a handwritten note with the current date to verify possession.
response.reason: Only the retail packaging is visible. It is impossible to verify the existence, condition, or authenticity of the camera without photos of the device itself.
